LLVM libc++abi and libunwind, revision 4434dabb69916856b824f68a64b029c67175e532.
The two unchanged ABI sources are compiled with the engine's existing LLVM 22.1.0
compiler and original sysroot headers, using legacy WebAssembly exceptions.
libunwind.a comes from WASI SDK 33; its debug sections were removed, with
executable/data section bytes unchanged. Both upstream license texts are exact.
provenance.json describes the original runtime-only archive, before these
notices and provenance were packaged alongside its three unchanged payloads.
